text:
Gina: Heads-up: deploybot blocked the scheduled change window for canary. CI artifact-verify failed during promote -> holding. Need a quick call: pin to previous canary, or attempt a cache-busted rebuild and reupload within the window? Logs below.

Deploy-bot: promotion-check failed for image redwood/edge@sha256:aa11bb
expected: sha256:aa11bb
observed-on-runner-cache-03: sha256:cc22dd
action: promotion blocked; manual decision required

Harold: Runner logs show an intermittent 502 from registry-us-west at 04:02 UTC and an incomplete multi-part commit. Looks like some layers never made it to the final manifest.

Ivy: If we rebuild now we might hit the same transient registry failure. Change window is 50m left. I lean to pinning so we don't risk missing the window for customers.

Ken: Agree with pin. Manual promote to last known good sha256:998877 keeps the window. We should also add a short note in release-notes: "Promotion paused due to artifact verification mismatch; pinned to previous canary." and link the rebuild PR.

Gina: Ok pin it is unless someone objects. Who can run the manual promote and watch smoke? Liam?

Liam: I can do it. Command I'll run:```/deploybot promote --image sha256:998877 --env canary --reason "pin after artifact verify mismatch"```I'll watch canary metrics for 15m and abort if http_5xx_rate > 0.8% or p50 latency jumps > 100ms.

release-bot: auto-checklist: update drafts/4.x/release-notes.md, attach incident link if registry errors persist, include rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback-canary.md

Harold: I'll open an incident for registry-us-west and queue a cache-purge for runner-cache-03. Also creating a rebuild PR with explicit --cache-bust and --atomic-upload flags. CI snippet I'll add:```- run: ./ci/build-image --tag=edge:canary-rebuild --cache-bust --upload-opts="--atomic"```

Ivy: Also add a verify stage that pulls the uploaded image from the same registry and checks sha256 before any promote. That should catch the partial-commit case before blocking a change window.

Deploy-bot: Manual promote command received from Liam. Status: queued -> promoting -> smoke-run started. :eyes:

Liam: Smoke @ +6m: error-rate 0.25%, p95 latency stable. Still watching 9m. Added ephemeral alert: canary_http_5xx > 0.8% for 10m.

Harold: Cache purge job started for runner-cache-03 and attached to INC-2026-11. ETA ~4m.

Deploy-bot: smoke-run passed. Promotion complete. Canary now running sha256:998877.

Gina: Thanks. Action items: Harold file registry incident + purge, open rebuild PR and mark for overnight verified reupload, Ivy add verify-stage to CI, Ken update release-notes draft with the pinned note and rollback steps, Liam to watch metrics for a total of 15m. We'll mark the change window used and reopen if any post-promote anomalies.

Ken: Adding release notes line now and linking the rebuild PR once Harold posts it. Also adding a short rollback snippet in the notes:```/deploybot promote --image sha256:aa11bb --env canary --reason "rollback to blocked image after rebuild verification"```

Gina: Closing this thread for now. Reopen if the registry incident shows further errors or the smoke fails.
